summary_en: This cooking show video demonstrates the preparation of braised pork trotters with coconut water in a modern studio kitchen. A male chef and a female assistant introduce ingredients, marinate the pork with spices like cinnamon and star anise, and then sauté and simmer it in a clay pot with coconut water and grated pear until tender. The finished dish is garnished with herbs and white sesame seeds on a wooden board before the show concludes.
